title: Repair OpenAI Agents SDK tool registration

requirementAssessments.evidence: The actor report identifies the stale canonical name find_order and contrasts it with the source-established lookup_order. Current src/tools.ts declares name: 'lookup_order', while the repaired moldea/moldea.yaml now matches it.

moldea/moldea.yaml declares tools.lookup-order.name as lookup_order. Workspace assertions show only that manifest changed, and its current SHA-256 matches the asserted post-change hash; src/agent.ts, src/tools.ts, src/contracts.ts, and src/implementations.ts retain their asserted pre-change hashes.

The manifest still binds supportAgent and loadSupportInstruction in src/agent.ts, lookupOrderTool in src/tools.ts, lookupOrder in src/implementations.ts, and both schema symbols in src/contracts.ts. Source confirms a direct new Agent definition with tools: [lookupOrderTool], canonical instruction loading, tool execute: lookupOrder, and exact input/output schema registration. Deterministic inspection and validation are valid with empty failures, and type checking passed. The evidence is correctly limited to static detection and wiring, without claiming runtime execution.
